Let $\mathbb F$ be a non-archimedean local field, and
let $L$ be the group of rational points of a connected reductive
algebraic group $\mathbf{L}$ defined over $\mathbb F$.

A FORMULA OF ARTHUR AND AFFINE HECKE ALGEBRAS
ERIC OPDAM AND MAARTEN SOLLEVELD
Abstract. Let π, π′ be tempered representations of an aﬃne Hecke algebra with
positive parameters. We study their Euler–Poincar´e pairing EP(π, π′), the alter-

expressed in a simple formula involving an analytic R-group, analogous to a for-
mula of Arthur in the setting of reductive p-adic groups. Our proof applies equally

blocks.title: Analytic R-groups for non-tempered representations
blocks.content:
In this section we extend the definitions and results from Section \ref{sec:RgroupTemp}
(which stem from \cite{DeOp2}) to non-tempered induction data $\xi \in \Xi \setminus \Xi_{un}$.
One approach would be to define the R-group of $\xi = (P,\delta,t)$ to be that of
$\xi_{un} = (P,\delta ,t \,|t|^{-1})$. This works out well in most cases, but it is unsatisfactory
if the isotropy group $\mc W_{\xi_{un}}$ is strictly larger than $\mc W_\xi$.
